meta.landingTitle: Tipper — a better way to say thank you
meta.landingDescription: Simple, cashless tipping for the places that have traditionally been left out. Scan a QR code, choose an amount, and leave a tip in seconds.

hero.title: A better way to say thank you.
hero.text: Not every great service happens in a restaurant. From your morning coffee to a fresh haircut or a visit to your local bakery, there are people making your everyday experiences better — but they don't always have a way to receive tips.

how.title: From “thank you” to your bank account, in four steps.

steps.title: Put up your Tipper code
steps.text: We give you a QR sticker and an NFC tag with your own unique link. Stick them by the till, on the counter or on the cup sleeve.

steps.title: The guest scans or taps
steps.text: They point their phone camera at the QR code, or just tap the NFC tag. Your tip page opens instantly, with no app to download.

steps.title: They pay in two taps
steps.text: They choose an amount and pay with Apple Pay or Google Pay. No card numbers to type.

steps.title: You get paid at the end of the day
steps.text: All of the day's tips are transferred to your bank account, with a clear record of every tip.

contact.text: Write to us and we'll get you set up with your own QR code and NFC tag.

story.title: That's where Tipper comes in.
story.text: We bring simple, cashless tipping to the places that have traditionally been left out. With just a QR code, customers can show their appreciation in seconds, directly from their phones.
story.points: No cash needed. No complicated setup. Just a simple way to make someone's day a little better.

items.title: For customers
items.text: Show appreciation whenever you want. Scan a QR code, choose an amount, and leave a tip in just a few taps.

items.title: For employees
items.text: Get recognized for the work you do. Every tip is an opportunity to feel appreciated for making someone's day better.

items.title: For small businesses
items.text: Offer a modern tipping experience without complicated infrastructure, expensive equipment, or the need to change how your business operates.

closing.title: Because great service shouldn't go unnoticed.
closing.text: We believe everyone who makes someone's day better deserves the opportunity to be appreciated.
